profiles.shortDescription: Hoyer Motors develops electric motors and drive solutions for industrial and marine applications. Its official range covers IE-efficiency motors, brake motors, explosion-protected motors, medium-voltage motors and drive or control equipment.
fullDescription: Svend Hoyer A/S is a Danish electric-motor company founded in 1974 and headquartered in Hadsten. The Hoyer Motors portfolio includes standard industrial motors across international efficiency classes, brake motors, explosion-protected motors, medium-voltage motors and drive or control solutions. The documented range supports industrial machinery, process equipment and marine installations that require application-specific motor configurations.

profiles.shortDescription: Hydrovane is CompAir's range of rotary sliding-vane air compressors. The official portfolio includes compact and industrial packages for continuous-duty compressed-air service across OEM, laboratory, packaging, printing and machine-tool applications.
fullDescription: Hydrovane is a CompAir product brand focused on rotary sliding-vane compressors. Its documented portfolio spans compact HV01-04 units, HR04-07 packages and HV11-22 industrial systems, covering power ranges from small point-of-use installations to larger continuous-duty applications. CompAir identifies uses in original-equipment manufacture, printing, laboratories, dentistry, instrumentation, machine tools, packaging and robotics.

profiles.officialName: INA Drives & Mechatronics GmbH & Co. KG
profiles.shortDescription: IDAM, INA Drives & Mechatronics, develops direct-drive motors and mechatronic positioning systems within the Schaeffler Group. Its documented portfolio includes linear, rotary and planar direct-drive technologies for precision automation and machine applications.
fullDescription: INA Drives & Mechatronics, known as IDAM, is a Schaeffler Group specialist in direct-drive technology. Official Schaeffler documentation covers linear direct-drive motors, rotary direct-drive motors and systems, and planar reluctance drives. The product families are designed for dynamic and precise motion in machine tools, production equipment, measurement systems and other automation applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Johnson-Fluiten designs and manufactures rotary joints and sealing systems for transferring fluids between stationary and rotating machine components. Its range covers water, thermal oil, coolant, hydraulic oil and compressed-air service, including single- and multi-passage configurations.
fullDescription: Johnson-Fluiten S.r.l. is an Italian manufacturer established in 2003 and based in Pero near Milan. The company develops rotary joints and associated sealing technology for machines that transfer water, thermal oil, coolant, hydraulic oil, air and other process media into rotating equipment. Its official range includes R and RH joints, stainless-steel variants, G and BCI products, Z and Multipass configurations, RHB models and engineered custom solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: K+G Wetter manufactures processing machines for food production. Its official portfolio includes bowl cutters, vacuum cutters, grinders, mixer grinders and angle grinders for meat, seafood, vegetables, cheese, confectionery, sauces and pet-food applications.
fullDescription: K+G Wetter GmbH is a German food-processing machinery manufacturer founded in 1990 in Biedenkopf-Breidenstein. The company develops bowl cutters, vacuum bowl cutters, grinders, mixer grinders and angle grinders for preparing and reducing food ingredients. Its official application material covers meat and sausage products, seafood, vegetables and baby food, confectionery, pet food, vegetarian products, cheese and sauces.

profiles.shortDescription: Kortho develops coding and marking systems for industrial production and packaging lines. Its range covers thermal-transfer, thermal-inkjet and high-resolution inkjet printers, hot-foil and roll-coding equipment, plus software for managing print operations.
fullDescription: Kortho Coding & Marking is a Dutch manufacturer founded in Amsterdam in 1926 and now based in Katwijk. The official product range includes thermal-transfer overprinters, thermal-inkjet printers, high-resolution inkjet systems, hot-foil and roll-coding equipment, and software for controlling or integrating marking operations. The systems are intended for printing variable information, identification and traceability data on products and packaging.

profiles.shortDescription: Lachenmeier is a Signode brand for stretch-hood packaging systems. Its official solutions protect palletized loads through automated hood application for food, beverage, pharmaceutical, construction-material, chemical and appliance operations.
fullDescription: Lachenmeier is Signode's brand for stretch-hood wrapping technology. The documented range includes Multi FleXL, Power Flex T1 and Power Flex TL systems for applying protective stretch film to palletized loads. Signode positions the equipment for food and beverage, pharmaceutical, construction-material, chemical, insulation and appliance packaging where load protection and automated handling are required.

profiles.shortDescription: Mecafrance supplies industrial ball valves and related valve automation within Emerson's portfolio. The official product material covers manual and actuated valve configurations for process isolation and flow-control duties.
fullDescription: Mecafrance is an industrial valve brand within Emerson's portfolio. Its official site and technical material document ball valves, actuation options and accessories for isolating or controlling process media. The current German operation is based in Mönchengladbach and provides product information, documentation and support for Mecafrance valve applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Pentronic develops industrial temperature-measurement products and measurement systems. Its official portfolio includes thermocouples, resistance thermometers, pyrometers, transmitters, indicators, controllers, data loggers, calibration equipment and specialized process-measurement systems.
fullDescription: Pentronic AB is a Swedish measurement-technology company based in Västervik. The official product program covers temperature sensors such as thermocouples and Pt100 resistance thermometers, non-contact pyrometers, transmitters, indicators, controllers, loggers, calibration equipment, cables, connectors and mechanical accessories. Pentronic also documents dedicated measurement systems for process variables including flow and selected material properties.

profiles.shortDescription: Proportion-Air develops electronic pressure and flow-control equipment for pneumatic systems. Its official range includes electro-pneumatic pressure regulators, mass-flow control valves and pressure transducers for machine and process automation.
fullDescription: Proportion-Air, Inc. is a United States manufacturer founded in 1985. The company specializes in electronic control of air pressure and flow, with an official portfolio that includes electro-pneumatic pressure regulators, mass-flow control valves and pressure transducers. Product series such as QPV, MPV, QL3, SPV and QB support closed-loop pneumatic control in automated equipment and process applications.

profiles.shortDescription: RICKMEIER manufactures gear pumps, pump units, valves and complete oil-supply systems. The company develops these products in Balve for lubrication, cooling and circulation duties in industrial machinery and drive systems.
fullDescription: RICKMEIER GmbH is a German fluid-technology manufacturer based in Balve. Its official portfolio combines gear pumps and pump units, valves, engineered oil-supply systems and application engineering. RICKMEIER documents the equipment for lubrication, cooling, circulation and transfer duties in gearboxes, turbines, compressors, machine tools and other industrial systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Salvatore Robuschi manufactures centrifugal pumps for industrial process applications. Its official portfolio includes horizontal and vertical process pumps, vortex and channel-impeller designs, and cantilever configurations for clean, contaminated or solids-bearing fluids.
fullDescription: Salvatore Robuschi & C. S.r.l. is an Italian industrial-pump manufacturer based in Parma. The company develops centrifugal process pumps in horizontal, vertical and cantilever configurations, with hydraulic designs selected for clean liquids, contaminated fluids and media containing suspended solids. Its official range serves chemical processes, wastewater, food, general industry and other demanding fluid-transfer applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Siempelkamp develops machinery and production plants for wood-based panels, composite materials and metal forming, together with casting and nuclear-service capabilities. Its plant-engineering portfolio covers complete production lines and associated process technologies.
fullDescription: G. Siempelkamp GmbH & Co. KG is a German industrial technology company headquartered in Krefeld. Its official activities include machinery and complete plants for producing wood-based panels and composite materials, metal-forming presses, casting technology and services for nuclear facilities. The portfolio combines process engineering, production equipment, automation and lifecycle support for large industrial installations.

profiles.shortDescription: TAKISAWA manufactures CNC lathes, conventional lathes, machining centres and automated production systems. Its machine-tool portfolio includes turning, mill-turn, multi-tasking and factory-automation platforms.
fullDescription: TAKISAWA MACHINE TOOL CO., LTD. is a Japanese machine-tool manufacturer founded in 1922 and headquartered in Okayama. The official product scope includes CNC lathes, engine lathes, machining centres, drill centres and factory-automation cells or systems. TAKISAWA's documented machine families address general turning, multi-axis and mill-turn processing, vertical turning and automated production.

profiles.shortDescription: Tecwill develops modular and mobile concrete batching plants and control systems. Its official solutions cover ready-mix, precast and on-site concrete production with relocatable plant configurations and automated dosing or mixing technology.
fullDescription: Tecwill Oy is a Finnish concrete-plant technology company based in Joensuu. The company develops modular, mobile and stationary batching plants for ready-mix, precast and on-site production. Its official offering combines aggregate storage, dosing, mixing, recycling and automation technologies in plant families designed for different capacity, mobility and installation requirements.

profiles.shortDescription: Vogelsang develops pumps, grinders, macerators and handling systems for fluid and solids-intensive processes. Its official portfolio supports wastewater, agriculture, biogas, transport and industrial applications.
fullDescription: Vogelsang GmbH & Co. KG is a German manufacturer headquartered in Essen (Oldenburg). Its official product program includes rotary-lobe pumps, grinders and macerators, solid-matter feeders, liquid-manure spreading and distribution equipment, and engineered systems for wastewater and biogas operations. The technologies are documented for municipal treatment, agriculture, transport, food processing and other industrial fluid-handling duties.

profiles.shortDescription: Vokes is a Cleanova filtration brand for air, gas and liquid process applications. Its documented range includes particulate filtration, oil-mist elimination and replacement filter elements for industrial equipment.
fullDescription: Vokes is part of Cleanova's industrial filtration brand portfolio. Cleanova's official Vokes product directory covers air and gas particulate filtration, oil-mist elimination, liquid filtration and replacement elements. These products support contamination control and equipment protection across industrial air, gas and liquid systems.

profiles.shortDescription: VTS Group develops HVAC equipment for ventilation, heating and air distribution. Its official portfolio includes air-handling units, air curtains, fan-coil units and heating units for commercial and industrial buildings.
fullDescription: VTS Group is an HVAC equipment manufacturer with an international product and service network. The official portfolio includes VENTUS air-handling units, WING air curtains, VOLCANO heating units and fan-coil solutions. These systems are used to condition, heat and distribute air in commercial, public and industrial buildings.
